article.title: Recovery of specific immovable property.
article.content: A person entitled to the possession of specific immovable property may recover it in the manner provided by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908).
article.html:
5Recovery of specific immovable property.

Section 5 · Part II · Chapter I · page 4 of the Act

A person entitled to the possession of specific immovable property may recover it in the manner provided by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908).
